subject.title: refactor(qqbot): inject the live config accessor

question: Should QQBot intentionally stop using its startup configuration and surface processing failures whenever the live runtime-config lifecycle is unavailable?
rationale: This branch removes an existing fallback from a deployed channel routing path; repository policy treats fallback removal and new operator-visible failure behavior as a maintainer product decision, even when the refactor is technically sound.

options.title: Adopt explicit failure
options.body: Accept explicit processing errors as the safer outcome than silently routing messages with obsolete bindings, after live evidence confirms the operational behavior.

options.title: Retain a bounded compatibility path
options.body: Keep a documented temporary fallback or migration plan if maintainers conclude existing deployments must continue processing during runtime-config lifecycle faults.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit failure
recommendation.body: Accept explicit processing errors as the safer outcome than silently routing messages with obsolete bindings, after live evidence confirms the operational behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context ties steipete directly to the proposed QQBot runtime-boundary and fallback-contract change.
